Check that KGST/USDT trading is available in your country or region of residence.
Trade KGST/USDT on spot between October 14, 2026 00:00 and January 13, 2027 23:59 (UTC). The text mentions no registration step.

watch: KGST is a stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the Kyrgyz som (KGS), not to the dollar. Its price in USDT moves with the som's exchange rate, so you can lose value even without fees.
